rationale: The coverage-expansion motive is legitimate, but `wcap` (act−lct) contains cash and debt-in-current-liabilities, so `oibdp − DELTA(wcap)` mechanically penalizes exactly the cash accumulation the hypothesis calls "cash thrown off by operations" and rewards short-term borrowing — it is not the intended operating-cash-flow proxy, and it interacts perversely with the cash-level runway leg it is conjoined with.

target_name: Cash Profitability With Net Cash Runway
rationale: This is a one-variable swap (gross cash → cash net of `dlc`) inside the archive's already-tested best conjunction, with both legs previously evaluated separately, so it is close to a cosmetic recombination whose incremental information is likely small and whose coverage stays pinned at ~0.08 by `oancf`.

A genuinely different decomposition of debt-service capacity — unit-economics margin conjoined with sales scale per dollar of claims — with legs orthogonal to the ROA/cash-cushion pairings already tested, high expected coverage, and a sign direction that matches the expression's natural orientation.

This is essentially the archived "Solvency Conjunction Net Of Accrual Penalty" with upgraded legs, and it double-loads `oancf` (positively in the MIN leg and again positively via −(oiadp−oancf)), so the "accrual penalty" is partly a repackaged second copy of the cash-profitability leg rather than an independent tail.

target_name: Cash Richness Versus Cost Coverage Ablation
rationale: As a diagnostic the ablation is well-designed and decision-relevant, but as a standalone signal it is a conjunction of two well-published anomalies (cash-flow profitability and cash-to-assets) and offers no new economic content if it happens to work.

The liability-composition angle is a real dimension (Nissim–Penman-style financing vs operating liabilities), but the expression differs from the archived "Conjunction With Rollover Risk Leg" only by broadening the numerator from `dlc` to `dltt+dlc` over the same `lt` denominator with the same profitability leg, so it will likely be highly correlated with an already-evaluated signal.
